discover.title:
Find the best roads
near you.
discover.body: Coastal, twisty, scenic… See the routes in your area on the map and find fuel stations and mechanics along the way.

record.title:
Ride the route, record
every kilometre.
record.body: Follow the route with voice guidance and add stops. Your distance, time and speed are recorded automatically.

share.title:
Share your journey
your way.
share.body: Share your ride with photos, save routes and share your rides with templates.

existing.title: Welcome back!
existing.subtitle: Enter the password for your {{email}} account.

new.title: Welcome!
new.subtitle: Create a password to join ROLT and have it ride along on your motorcycle trips.

locked.title: Too many failed attempts
locked.message_one: For your security, we’ve paused sign-in for {{count}} minute. If you don’t want to wait, you can reset your password.
locked.message_other: For your security, we’ve paused sign-in for {{count}} minutes. If you don’t want to wait, you can reset your password.
locked.retryInA11y_one: You can try again in about {{count}} minute.
locked.retryInA11y_other: You can try again in about {{count}} minutes.
locked.unlocked: The wait is over, you can try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address linked to your account. We’ll send you a link to reset your password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.subtitle: We’ve sent a password reset link to {{email}}.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must be at least 8 characters.

passwordUpdated.title: Password updated
passwordUpdated.subtitle: You can keep using ROLT with your new password.

linkedAccount.title: This account uses {{provider}}
linkedAccount.subtitle: {{email}} is linked to your {{provider}} account. Sign in with {{provider}} instead of a password to continue.

resetLinkExpired.subtitle: For your security, password reset links are valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can only be used once. Request a new link to continue.

emailVerification.title: Verify your email address
emailVerification.subtitle: Tap the link we sent to your email to verify your account. If you can’t find the email, check your spam folder.
emailVerification.expiredSubtitle_one: For your security, verification links are valid for {{count}} hour. Send a new link to continue.
emailVerification.expiredSubtitle_other: For your security, verification links are valid for {{count}} hours. Send a new link to continue.

saveRoute.title: Sign in to save this route
saveRoute.description: With a free account you can save routes, record your rides and match with riders nearby.

followRider.title: Sign in to follow
followRider.description: With a free account you can follow riders and hear about their new rides and routes.

likeRide.title: Sign in to like this ride
likeRide.description: With a free account you can like and comment on rides and record your own.

commentRide.title: Sign in to comment
commentRide.description: With a free account you can comment on and like rides and record your own.

saveRide.title: Sign in to save this ride
saveRide.description: With a free account you can save rides and routes and match with riders nearby.

reportContent.title: Sign in to report
reportContent.description: To keep the community safe, reports come from riders with an account.

blockRider.title: Sign in to block
blockRider.description: Blocks are tied to your account: blocked riders can't follow you or see your rides.

suggestRoute.title: Sign in to suggest a route
suggestRoute.description: Routes you suggest are published in Discover under your name after review. Get started with a free account.

sharePost.title: Sign in to share
sharePost.description: With a free account you can share your rides, photos and thoughts with the community and follow other riders.

generic.title: Sign in to continue
generic.description: This feature needs an account. With a free account you can save routes and rides and match with riders nearby.
